question: L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are seated around a round table facing the center. L sits fourth to the right of R. Only two people sit between Q and N when counted from the left of Q. M sits third to the left of O. S is an immediate neighbour of O and N. How many people sit between L and S when counted from the left of S?
solution:
Given: L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are seated around a round table facing the center.

1) L sits fourth to the right of R.

2) Only two people sit between Q and N when counted from the left of Q.

3) M sits third to the left of O.

4) S is an immediate neighbour of O and N. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f84bf3fd177de13dbe72f57f693e6a9bad40cdd457cb7730d07682b802bdc5.png] 

Here, **Four** people sit between L and S when counted from the left of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
